summary: CVC-PE Global Private Equity Fund, LP filed Form 8-K to report unregistered sales of limited partnership units under its continuous private offering, totaling approximately $37.0 million in August 2026, and disclosed its Transactional NAV per unit by class. The sales were made to investors, some through a related entity, and were exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D. This is a routine periodic disclosure of ongoing private offering activity and NAV calculation, not a special-situation event.
